selection_rule: Within each TP/FN/FP category, select the observation whose phishing score is nearest to that category's median score.
shap_scope: Local TreeSHAP explanations of Full CatBoost only; not an explanation of either stacking ensemble.
causal_warning: SHAP values explain model-output contributions and do not establish causal relationships in real phishing behavior.
display_note: SHAP contributions use transformed pipeline inputs; waterfall feature values are displayed on the original published scale.
